notes.title: Mythwrecked v1.07 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi, we’re still very solid with very few bug reports coming in, which is great! I've caught a few things internally so done a v1.07 patch (v1.05 and v1.06 were internal, hence the jump in version number) with the following fixes:-

[list]
[*] Edge case blocker bug where you can save after placing the final soulstone before triggering the endgame finale. On reload of that save, the endgame finale would not trigger.
[*] If you entered the South-Western beach at exactly 5am then the stars would remain in the sky for the rest of the day in that location.
[*] On very old PCs/Laptops we've had a report of the player character remaining tiny when emerging from fast travel. We can't replicate this, even on a 15 year-old laptop, but have made a change that we think will fix the issue. 
[*] Save benches, the mosaic and the chillout blanket did not have a highlight in the Atrium scene
[*] Fixed a couple of minor visual bugs
[/list]

That's it! Thanks for playing.

notes.title: Mythwrecked V1.04 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Happy to report that we've had very few bugs reported so this is just a minor update. The fixes for V1.04 are as follows:-

-Fixed rare progression blocker where you can sprint from a non-Hermes friend favour to a gull and skip the dialogue quickly, meaning his points aren't allocated directly. 

-Fixed a typo in the game's final scene

notes.title: Steam Deck - Ready to Go!!!
notes.content:
[h3] STEAM DECK - READY TO GO![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076070/63a14a5db63b5a78bd0abebd441d8314a4e5f663.jpg[/img]
Hi, Alex from Polygon Treehouse here.

I love playing games on the Steam Deck, in fact it's my go-to way of playing games on Steam. Because of this it's been really important to make sure our own game is working well on the device! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076070/091bad3172cd7526832c07877891a270b355b6d0.png[/img]

Whilst Mythwrecked is not officially Deck verified [i]just [/i]yet, we're happy to report our own findings:-
[list]
[*] The game was built from the ground up with the [b]Steam Deck as the benchmark[/b] way to play
[*] The game runs great, not breaking a sweat at [b]60FPS[/b]
[*] All text is [b]very readable[/b]
[*] [b]Steam Deck specific button icons[/b] are shown on screen for any UI
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076070/d8325e31bb8290ec11c0faf90dd51b062b60fb8b.jpg[/img]
That's it we'll keep it short and sweet. We look forward to welcoming you, and your Steam Deck to Ambrosia Island.

Thanks for reading,
Alex & Team

notes.title: Mythwrecked Launches Dec 5th, 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076070/f78a7edbacab695663dd39ca0ea1f06cd80087a3.png[/img][h3]RELEASE DATE REVEALED![/h3]
Hi everyone, Alex here! Yesterday we revealed [i]Mythwrecked: Ambrosia Island's[/i] release date as part of the opening broadcast of Cozy Quest 2024. I'm stoked to say the game will be out in the wild on [b]DECEMBER 5TH, 2024[/b]! So in just a few short weeks we look forward to welcoming you to the shore of Ambrosia Island. 

It's been a long road to get here, taking part in many events, winning awards and listening to feedback to make Mythwrecked a modern adventure game to remember. We really appreciate all the support we've gotten along the way, so thanks very much folks.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076070/1d406a8c944c056033a7bf6603d906a413680c09.jpg[/img][h3]COZY QUEST DEMO IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
As you might have seen, Mythwrecked was part of the Official Selection for Cozy Quest 2024. We took the opportunity to address some player feedback in our Demo.  Alex can now explore and interact with things a little more at the very start of the demo and you can now also choose to play in French, German and LATAM Spanish! There's also some art and animation polish and bug fixes in their too!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076070/091bad3172cd7526832c07877891a270b355b6d0.png[/img][h3]STEAM DECK[/h3]
I love playing games on the Steam Deck, in fact it's my go-to way of playing games on Steam. Because of this it's been really important to make sure our own game is working well on the device! Whilst Mythwrecked is not officially Deck verified [i]just [/i]yet, we're happy to report our own findings:-
[list]
[*] The game runs great, not breaking a sweat at 60FPS
[*] All text is very readable
[*] Steam Deck specific button icons are shown on screen for any UI
[/list] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076070/63a14a5db63b5a78bd0abebd441d8314a4e5f663.jpg[/img]
[h3]FOLLOW THE ADVENTURE[/h3]
That’s all for now, but don’t forget you can keep up to date on Mythwrecked: Ambrosia Island by following our [url=https://bsky.app/profile/polygontreehouse.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/PolyTreehouse]Twitter[/url], joining our [url=https://discord.gg/polygontreehouse]Discord[/url] or subscribing to the  [url=https://polygon-treehouse.us15.list-manage.com/subscribe?id=2dff9a9eea&u=59bce81f10b6c1086a6eda675]Polygon Treehouse Newsletter[/url].

Until next time, 
Alex & Team

notes.title: Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games is going live September 11 - 14!
notes.content:
[h2]Get ready![/h2]

Join us September 11 - 14 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Save & Sound features concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 3-day live show from September 11 - 13 will showcase original content made just for Save & Sound. 

We'll have an EXCLUSIVE Mythwrecked: Ambrosia Island music featurette going live for the event featuring a live performance by the game's composer, Aether.

[h2]Don’t miss out on updates![/h2]

Set a reminder to be notified when Save & Sound will go live!

The show will be streamed on the Save & Sound website, YouTube, and Twitch. Check out all the games part of the event on [url=saveandsound.io]saveandsound.io[/url]

notes.title: Access-Ability Summer Showcase!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076070/ef71b233af146c29dfa81084883803724fd4d9b6.jpg[/img]

[h3]ACCESSIBILITY FEATURES SHOWCASED[/h3]
Hey everyone! We were super excited to take part in the first ever Access-Ability Summer Showcase recently. It's a brand new event to highlight the accessibility settings and features of upcoming games. 

One of our mantras at Polygon Treehouse is ‘[i]Adventure for All[/i]’, so we’ve been putting a lot of effort into accessibility, building on our experience with [i]Röki[/i] to make sure as many folks can enjoy our new game as possible. 

[b]Here’s a list of the accessibility features we showcased:-[/b]
[list]
[*] High-contrast text / backgrounds with text presented in a readable sans-serif font by default for greater visual clarity
[*] Dark and light mode text display options
[*] Several dialogue scrolling options, including dialogue speed settings, no dialogue scrolling, and dialogue auto-play
[*] Visual, audio, and haptic feedback to alert players as they solve puzzles and explore
[*] Dynamic tracking camera
[*] Sprint toggle 
[*] Full button/key remapping
[*] Haptics toggle
[*] Non-Dialogue Captions for ambient and environmental sound effects
[/list]
[h3]WATCH THE SHOWCASE[/h3]
You can watch the Mythwrecked segment (voiced by accessibility guru Britt Dye, who we’ve been collaborating with on the game) [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_U4dtCHjFBc&t=6s]here[/url] and the full showcase can be enjoyed [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P--rmXifm3U&t=26s]here[/url].

[h3]FOLLOW THE ADVENTURE[/h3]
That’s all for now, but don’t forget you can keep up to date on Mythwrecked: Ambrosia Island by following our [url=https://twitter.com/PolyTreehouse]Twitter[/url], joining our [url=https://discord.gg/polygontreehouse]Discord[/url] or subscribing to the  [url=https://polygon-treehouse.us15.list-manage.com/subscribe?id=2dff9a9eea&u=59bce81f10b6c1086a6eda675]Polygon Treehouse Newsletter[/url].

Until next time, 
Alex & Team
